WITH params AS (SELECT DATE '2026-09-27' AS week_ending),
closing AS (
    SELECT cp.category, SUM(fs.closing_units) AS closing_units
    FROM fact_stock_week fs
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = fs.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = fs.product_key
    JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE fs.week_ending_date = params.week_ending AND s.store_id < 900 AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    GROUP BY 1
),
sold AS (
    SELECT cp.category,
           SUM(CASE WHEN f.sale_date BETWEEN params.week_ending - 34 AND params.week_ending - 7 THEN f.quantity END) AS units_prior4,
           SUM(CASE WHEN f.sale_date BETWEEN params.week_ending - 27 AND params.week_ending THEN f.quantity END) AS units_p05
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN params.week_ending - 34 AND params.week_ending
      AND s.store_id < 900 AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT c.category, c.closing_units, s.units_prior4, s.units_p05,
       ROUND(c.closing_units / (s.units_prior4 / 4.0), 2) AS woc_prior4,
       ROUND(c.closing_units / (s.units_p05 / 4.0), 2) AS woc_p05
FROM closing c LEFT JOIN sold s USING (category) ORDER BY 1

SELECT count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS d_id, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS d_rl, count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) AS loads,
 sum(CASE WHEN quantity<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nonpos_qty, min(quantity) AS minq, max(quantity) AS maxq,
 sum(CASE WHEN staff_purchase_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS staff

FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-24' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND s.store_id<900
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH params AS (SELECT DATE '2026-09-27' AS week_ending), closing AS (SELECT cp.category, SUM(fs.closing_units) AS closing_units FROM fact_stock_week fs JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = fs.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = fs.product_key JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current CROSS JOIN params WHERE fs.week_ending_date = params.week_ending AND s.store_id < 900 AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test' GROUP BY 1), sold AS (SELECT cp.category, SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold_4w FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current CROSS JOIN params WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN params.week_ending - 34 AND params.week_ending - 7 AND s.store_id < 900 AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 5 AS fiscal_period, c.category, ROUND(c.closing_units / (s.units_sold_4w / 4.0), 1) AS weeks_of_cover
FROM closing c JOIN sold s USING (category) ORDER BY c.category
